dashboard.label: AD Health & Performance
dashboard.description: Domain controller health and performance: AD health-check, Netlogon and DNS-health events flagging problems, data freshness per DC, and Perfmon counters for NTDS (LDAP, replication queue, threads), CPU, DNS and DFS replicated folders. Problem events are detected by keywords (macro adx_problem_terms) because the free-text health sources have no fixed schema.
